test_objective: Query entities with Entity Type Selection Language.
keywords: Query entities using Entity Type Selection Language

test_cases.name: 019_08_01 query with one type
test_cases.doc: Query entities with Entity Type Selection Language.
test_cases.template: Query entities using Entity Type Selection Language
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entities Request: and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to '${entity_types_selection}' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"'
}
